about: Who may do what. A SKILL is a written area of responsibility (skills/<name>/SKILL.md): what it is in charge of, its rules, and the tools it may use. A TOOL is one specific action (tools/<name>/tool.json) that code runs when a model asks for it; all tools are read-only. A JOB is one internal call to a model with a fixed prompt and output schema (jobs/<name>/), usually what answers a tool. A skill is told to the call agent from SKILL.md and to the chat agent from chat.md beside it. An agent is given the skills listed here, and only the tools those skills name for its channel. tests/docs.test.ts checks this file against the folders and against what each model is actually given.

jobs.name: plan-queries
jobs.does: Writes the search queries for the first search of a chat answer.

jobs.name: ask
jobs.does: Writes the checked chat answer: steps with a page and a quote each, suggested checks, a hazard flag, figures.

jobs.name: rerank
jobs.does: Orders the sections a search found and drops the ones that do not answer.

jobs.name: english
jobs.does: Writes the technician's question in English when the live model gave none, so an English manual is found by words too.

jobs.name: look
jobs.does: Looks at one camera picture: finds a named part, what a finger points at, or says what is visible.

jobs.name: identify
jobs.does: Sample fault trees: classifies a fault from a picture or a description.

jobs.name: interpret
jobs.does: Sample fault trees: reads a free-text reply as yes, no or unclear.
